parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649942. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, and left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL4649942, non-null standard_value, and standard_relation '='. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
